Australian Veal Beef Liver: Veal liver from Australia, finer-grained and milder than liver from a full-grown cow. Rich and faintly sweet, with the deep mineral note liver is bought for.
Beef and Lamb Kofta: Beef and lamb, seasoned and shaped into kofta here in the shop. Juicy and gently spiced — fuller than a plain beef patty, without a strong lamb flavour.
Beef Burger Patties 2-pack: Beef ground and pressed into two patties here, in three seasonings. Loose-textured and beef-forward rather than springy, the way a hand-made patty is.
Brazilian Beef Tenderloin Steak: Brazilian grass-fed tenderloin, the leanest and most tender cut on the counter. Mild and buttery with very little fat, so the flavour is delicate rather than big.
Brazilian Chuckeye Steak: Brazilian grass-fed chuck eye, cut from the shoulder end of the rib. Strongly beefy and nicely marbled — close to ribeye flavour for less money.
Brazilian Ground Beef (from Chuckeye): Brazilian grass-fed chuck eye, ground here in the shop. Deeply beefy, with enough fat running through it to stay rich rather than dry.
Brazilian Ground Beef (from Ribeye): Brazilian grass-fed ribeye, ground here in the shop. Fattier than the chuck eye grind, with a fuller and more buttery beef flavour.
Brazilian Ribeye Steak: Brazilian grass-fed ribeye, marbled through the middle with a band of fat. Rich and juicy, the most full-flavoured of the Brazilian steaks.
Brazilian Sukiyaki Cut 1kg: Brazilian beef sliced paper-thin across the grain. Tender and clean-tasting, mild enough to carry whatever it is seasoned with.
Homemade Bacon (Sausage Guy): Pork belly bacon in three cures — wood smoked, natural and honey. Meaty and streaked with fat; the cure decides how strong it tastes.
Lamb Burger 2- pack: Lamb ground and pressed into two patties here in the shop. Richer and more distinctly flavoured than beef, with the sweetness lamb fat brings.
Lamb Shanks: The lower foreleg of the lamb, on the bone, with plenty of connective tissue through it. Deep and sweet-savoury — the most strongly lamb-flavoured cut here.
Ostrich Ground 1kg (Big Bird): Ground ostrich from Big Bird. Dark red and very lean, closer to beef than to poultry, with a cleaner and slightly sweeter flavour.
Ostrich Steak (Big Bird): Ostrich steak from Big Bird — dark red meat with almost no fat in it. Tender and mild, beef-like but lighter and a touch sweeter.
Picnic Bacon: Bacon cut from the pork shoulder rather than the belly. Meatier and less fatty than belly bacon, with a firmer bite.
USDA Choice Angus Ribeye (St. Helens): Imported US Angus ribeye, graded USDA Choice, from St. Helens. Grain-fed and well marbled, so it eats richer and sweeter than grass-fed beef.
USDA Choice Black Angus Ribeye (Demkota): Imported US Black Angus ribeye, graded USDA Choice, from Demkota. Generous marbling through the eye gives it a buttery, full beef flavour.
USDA Choice Black Angus Ribeye(Nebraska): Imported US Black Angus ribeye, graded USDA Choice, from Nebraska. Grain-fed and well marbled — rich and juicy, mild rather than gamey.
USDA Prime Excel Chuckeye: Imported US chuck eye graded USDA Prime, the grade above Choice. Strongly beefy and heavily marbled — the most flavourful of the shoulder cuts.
USDA Tenderloin: Imported US tenderloin, the leanest and most tender cut of beef. Fine-grained and mild, bought for its soft texture more than a big flavour.
Beef Pastrami: Beef cured with pepper and coriander, then smoked, sliced to order. Peppery and smoky with a firm bite, drier than most cold cuts.
Beef Salami: Air-dried beef salami, sliced to order. Dense and tangy, salty with a firm chew.
Chicken Ham: Cooked chicken ham, sliced to order. Pale and tender with a light, clean flavour — the gentlest ham on the counter.
Cooked Ham: Cooked pork ham, sliced to order. Mild, lightly salty and tender; the plainest of the hams and the easiest to put with anything.
Farmers Ham (200g Pack): Pork ham in a 200g pack. Firm and savoury, more robust in flavour than plain cooked ham.
Florentiner: A finely ground German-style cold cut, sliced to order. Smooth and mild, lightly seasoned rather than spicy or smoky.
Forest Ham (200g Pack): Smoked pork ham in a 200g pack. Darker and smokier than cooked ham, firm and strongly savoury.
Honey Ham (200g Pack): Pork ham cured with honey, in a 200g pack. Mild and tender with a clear sweet edge to it.
Lyoner: Very finely ground pork sausage sold as a cold cut, sliced to order. Smooth, pale and barely seasoned — the mildest slice here.
Meat Loaf (Sliced): Baked fine-ground meat loaf, sliced to order. Mild and savoury, smooth inside with a browned crust at the edge.
Mixed Cold Cuts (200g Pack): A 200g pack holding several of the counter's cold cuts together. A spread of mild, smoked and spiced slices, for trying a few at once.
Mortadella: Very finely ground pork studded with cubes of white fat, sliced to order. Silky and mild, delicately peppered.
Pepperoni Lyoner: Lyoner with pepperoni worked through it, sliced to order. Smooth and mild like plain Lyoner, with pockets of gentle spice.
Polish (Beef Cold Cut): A beef cold cut in the Polish style, sliced to order. Savoury and garlicky, coarser and firmer than ham.
Turkey Ham: Cooked turkey ham, sliced to order. Pale and tender with a light, clean flavour.
Wood-Smoked Ham: Pork ham smoked over wood, sold by the piece. Firm and deeply savoury, with a strong clean smoke right through it.
Brazilian Chicken Breast 2kg: Boneless Brazilian chicken breast in a 2kg pack. Pale, lean meat with a mild clean flavour and a firm texture.
Brazilian Chicken Wings: Brazilian chicken wings. Small bony pieces with a lot of skin for their size, so they eat richer than breast meat.
Chicken Boneless Legs 2kg (Seara): Boneless chicken leg meat from Seara, in a 2kg pack. Darker and juicier than breast, with a fuller chicken flavour.
Duck Breast(Dalee): Duck breast from Dalee, with a thick layer of fat under the skin. Dark, close-grained meat with a deep, faintly gamey flavour.
Whole Brazilian Chicken 1.1kg (Seara): A whole Brazilian chicken from Seara, around 1.1kg. Mild and tender, with pale breast meat and darker, richer legs.
Whole Brazilian Chicken 1.3kg (Seara): A whole Brazilian chicken from Seara, around 1.3kg — the larger of the two sizes. Mild and tender, with pale breast and darker, richer legs.
Whole Chicken Leg 2kg (Coopavel): Whole chicken legs from Coopavel, thigh and drumstick together, in a 2kg pack. Dark meat, juicier and more strongly flavoured than breast.
Whole Peking Duck (2.5kg): A whole Peking duck of around 2.5kg, bred for a thick layer of fat under the skin. Dark, rich meat with a pronounced duck flavour.
Whole Turkey (Carolina): A whole turkey from Carolina. Pale breast meat with darker legs, milder than chicken and with little fat through it.
Chilean Mussels 1kg: Chilean mussels in the shell, 1kg. Sweet and briny with soft, tender meat.
Cream Dory 1kg: Boneless cream dory fillets, 1kg. White, very mild and soft-textured, with almost no fishy taste.
Half Shell Scallops 500g: Scallops served on the half shell, 500g. Sweet and delicate with a firm, meaty bite.
Pompano: Whole pompano, a local white fish. Firm, slightly oily flesh with a mild, sweet flavour and few bones.
Salmon Fillet: Salmon fillet, orange-pink and marbled with fat. Rich and buttery with a clean flavour.
Squid Rings 1kg: Cleaned squid cut into rings. Mild and faintly sweet, with a firm, springy bite.
Tuna Belly Small 1kg: Tuna belly, 1kg — the fattiest part of the fish. Soft and rich, far more marbled than the loin.
Tuna Fillet 500g: Tuna loin fillet, 500g. Dark red, lean and firm, with a clean and almost meaty flavour.
Butter Unsalted 200g (Arla): Unsalted butter from Arla, 200g. Clean and creamy with a sweet dairy flavour and no salt in it.
Cheddar Burger Slices 130g (Emborg): Processed cheddar slices from Emborg, 130g, cut to burger size. Mild and salty, and they melt smoothly without splitting.
Danish Blue Cheese 100g (Castello): Danish blue from Castello, 100g. Creamy and crumbly at once, salty and sharp with the strong tang of blue mould.
Emmenthaler (Emborg): Swiss-style Emmental from Emborg, cut to order. Firm and pale yellow with big holes through it; nutty and mildly sweet.
Goat Milk Icecream: Ice cream made with goat's milk. Creamy with the faint tang goat's milk brings, lighter than ice cream made from cow's milk.
Gran Amici (Emborg): A hard Italian-style grating cheese from Emborg, cut to order. Dry and grainy, salty and nutty.
Grana Padano (Emborg): Italian Grana Padano from Emborg, cut to order. Hard and grainy, salty and nutty — a little gentler than Parmigiano.
Grated Parmesan Cheese 226g (Euro Chef): Ready-grated parmesan from Euro Chef, 226g. Dry and fine, sharp and salty with a strong savoury hit.
Greek Yoghurt 500g (Naturalmind): Strained Greek-style yoghurt from Naturalmind, 500g. Thick enough to stand a spoon in, tart and fresh.
Homemade Yoghurt 500ml (Naturalmind): Yoghurt made in small batches by Naturalmind, 500ml. Looser than the Greek one, mildly tart and fresh-tasting.
Ice Cream: Ice cream by the tub. Cold, sweet and creamy — ask at the counter which flavours are in today.
Kefir Homemade: A fermented milk drink, made in small batches. Thin and pourable, sharply tart with a light natural fizz.
Mozzarella Cheese Block (Sausage Guy): A block of mozzarella under our own label, cut to order. Mild and milky with a springy texture, and it pulls into strands when it melts.
Mozzarella in Brine 100g (Bayernland): Fresh mozzarella kept in brine, from Bayernland, 100g. Soft and wet, very mild and milky with a light saltiness.
Premium Red Cheddar (Sausage Guy): Red cheddar under our own label, cut to order. Firm and deep orange, with a sharp savoury tang and a dry edge.
Sour Cream 250ml (Sausage Guy): Sour cream under our own label, 250ml. Thick and smooth with a clean, mild sourness.
White Cheddar (Emborg): Uncoloured cheddar from Emborg, cut to order. Firm and pale, savoury and tangy — the same cheddar bite without the orange.
